explanation: Band 3, +15.8% (17.7 -> 20.5 s), on the landing engine after the perf-audit's two corrections. (1) The canvas-wide seat region and free-ground grid (2.4 s of the growth) are now rasterized over a seating window round the seat, snapped to the canvas's cell grid, the grid deciding a cell past it by the same tests - the five pool hamlets byte-identical (perf-318-control-windows: 9.64 -> 7.56 s over the four 15-household seatings; the bookend 22.2 -> 20.5 s). (2) The 40-household web growth is the layout, not the web code 318 changed: seed 4's web is 3.52 s as it lands and 3.54 with the three web changes stubbed, seed 25's faster than main's (perf-318-control-web); seed 4's settle runs a second full pass. What remains: plan D4, the GM's ruling - the open seat nearest the field first, every direction and ring offered at once - is 1.9 s of the 2.8 (the control with D4 removed: 18.6 s), and buys a mean house-to-field distance of 355-394 ft against main's 416-443 (research.md R1); the last 0.9 s (+5%) is the growth with no radius. Seed 18 of the cohort, eleven margins thrown away on main, seats on its first in 2.4 s against 18.7 s.
